newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH LISTED FIRMS' 97 PROFITS TO GROW 34% - AKTIA.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH LISTED FIRMS' 97 PROFITS TO GROW 34% - AKTIA.

text.p: Aktia Bank said on Tuesday it expected listed Finnish companies' earnings to increase by 34 percent in 1997, and further by 32 percent in 1998.
"The current earnings estimates are based on a steady recovery of the European economy, and on consumer confidence remaining good," Aktia analyst Paivi Palomaki told a news conference.
Aktia forecast the stock market's aggregate price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio at 13.6 this year and at 10.2 in 1998. It expected dividends to grow 13 percent in 1997 and 11 percent in 1998.
But rapidly rising interest rates and sluggish growth in Europe could disrupt the current trend and lead to a downgrading of earnings estimates, Palomaki said.
